name: Phoenix Price Labels for WooCommerce
author: phoenixwp

sections.description:
Phoenix Price Labels for WooCommerce helps retail and omnichannel shops print shelf and product labels directly from WooCommerce — without cloud printing services or per-label fees. The plugin generates high-quality offline PDF files for standard A4 office printers.

Retail-first layouts include gross pricing, sale/regular text, and German unit price (PAngV) when your store provides unit price data (WooCommerce, German Market, Germanized, or configured meta).

Key Free Features

  • Offline PDF download — no external print service
  • Three Avery label sheets: L7159, L7160, L7163
  • Plain-paper strips: 30 mm and 39 mm height (cut and insert into shelf rails)
  • Product overview sheet (A4 catalog for checkout staff)
  • Fields: name, variation, gross price, sale/regular, unit price, SKU, EAN as text
  • Toggle fields on or off in the admin
  • Product picker and manual product IDs
  • Automatic title and price sizing for better shelf readability
  • Unlimited labels per run
  • HPOS compatible

Typical use cases

  • Print shelf labels for weekly promotions and regular price updates
  • Create quick product overview sheets for checkout or store staff
  • Keep label generation fully local without third-party print platforms
  • Reprint updated labels after catalog or campaign changes

Compatibility

  • WordPress 6.7+ and WooCommerce 8.0+
  • Tested with WooCommerce 10.9.3
  • Works with standard A4 office printer workflows
  • Unit-price output supported when unit data exists in your WooCommerce setup

Additionally in Pro

Price Labels Pro (annual license at 29 EUR / 29 USD per year via https://phoenixwp.com/preise/): EAN-13, Code 128, and QR scan codes, visual style presets, Badgemaker insert sheets, category bulk runs, and label offset printing. Activate your license under PhoenixWP Price Labels -> License.

Advanced features in Pro

  • Scannable barcode rendering (EAN-13, Code 128, QR)
  • Category-based bulk generation and repeat workflows
  • Offset printing for partially used sheets
  • Extended style presets and additional professional print workflows
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/phoenix-price-labels-for-woocommerce/ or install from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to PhoenixWP Price Labels, select products, choose a sheet preset, and download the PDF.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a cloud service or subscription?

No. PDFs are generated on your server. No third-party cloud connection, subscription, or per-label fees are required.

Where does unit price (Grundpreis / PAngV) come from?

The plugin reads unit price data from WooCommerce and common German compliance plugins (German Market, Germanized, PAngV meta). Configure fallback text under PhoenixWP Price Labels → Unit price settings if needed.

What paper formats are supported?

Standard A4 office printers. Included presets: three Avery sheets (L7159, L7160, L7163) and plain-paper strips in 30 mm and 39 mm widths.

Does this print scannable barcodes?

This release outputs EAN/GTIN as text on the label. Open the PDF in your system and print from your office printer.

Does this print directly to a thermal label printer?

The plugin outputs PDF files for office printers (A4/Letter). Thermal label printer presets may be added in a future release.

Can I use this without an internet connection after install?

Yes. PDF generation runs on your server. No cloud API is required.

Documentation and support: https://phoenixwp.com/support/
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Layout budget: product name and price scale up when optional label fields are hidden or empty — better readability on compact sheets.
  • Sheet-normalized title size: one title font size per sheet (based on the longest title that still fits).
  • Admin: short explanation of automatic title/price sizing at label fields.
  • Admin: Clear selection button for the product picker and optional product IDs.
  • Admin: Last selected sheet layout is remembered until you change it.
  • Fix: On dual-title sheets, a single-line product title no longer reserves an empty second title row.
  • Fix: Product overview table borders no longer draw extra frames around cell content.

1.2.0

  • Admin: Product picker and manual product ID selection are preserved when saving unit price settings.
  • Fix: Improved product title wrapping on compact Avery and plain-paper label sheets.
  • Confirmed compatibility with WooCommerce 10.9.3.

1.0.2

  • Confirmed compatibility with WooCommerce 10.9.1.
  • Standalone free plugin: full PDF label workflow without license gates or artificial label limits.
  • Badgemaker sheet presets removed from Free code (Pro-only via phoenixwp.com).
  • Retail-first readme and expanded FAQ (marketing copy refresh).

1.0.1

  • First wordpress.org submission attempt.

1.0.0

  • Launch release: offline PDF price labels for WooCommerce.
